screenshots.label: Sunnyside at golden hour in split screen: one skater pops off a manual pad by the blue bowl, the other rides the teal quarter pipe, palms and the beach town beyond the fence
Big Sky: one skater on the mega ramp deck by a token, the other carving the wooden giant quarter pipe, the car park and grass hills behind
Civic Plaza: a granite ledge grind throwing sparks, the fountain, street trees and brick blocks round the plaza
Rooftops at sunset: a parapet grind high over the street, downtown towers all round
